chunks: A number of our companions, from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr, from Ahmad ibn al-Mubarak, from al-Husayn ibn Ahmad ibn al-Minqari, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
The Sunnah regarding the Noura is every fifteen days, so if twenty days come upon you and it is not with you, then borrow upon Allah.
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended frequency for applying Noura according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Al-Kafi* establishes the Sunnah of applying *Noura* (whitewash) every fifteen days, reflecting the Shia emphasis on maintaining the physical purity and aesthetic beauty of one's dwelling as an act of worship. The instruction to 'borrow upon Allah' if one misses the deadline for twenty days highlights a merciful jurisprudential flexibility, encouraging believers to make up for missed rituals through sincere intention and divine reliance rather than strict penalty.

en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Sahl Bin Ziyad and Ali Bin Ibrahim, from his father, altogether from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Abu Nasr, from Ahmad Bin Al Mubarak, from Al Husayn Bin Ahmad Bin Al Minqary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘The Sunnah regarding Al-Noura is every fifteen days, so if twenty days were to come to you and it is not in your possession, so borrow upon Allahazwj’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Sahl ibn Ziyad and Ali ibn Ibrahim has narrated from his father from all Ahmad ibn Muhammad from ibn abu Nasr from Ahmad ibn al-Mubarak from al-Husayn ibn Ahmad al-Minqariy who has said the following: “Abu ‘ Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
The Sunnah about lime paste is to apply it after every fifteen days. If it becomes twenty days but you do not have it, you must borrow on the account of Allah.’”
